name: @penguinharness/a2ui
description: Rich reply blocks for readable output: a choice, a form, a procedure in steps, a callout, a Mermaid diagram, a basic chart drawn from data (line, area, bar, pie, scatter, histogram or gauge), and glanceable widgets built on those charts (a weather card, a dashboard of gauges for a quota, a budget or a job's progress, and a system-resource board) beside a live clock or countdown, each written as a fenced block inside an ordinary Markdown reply, rendered by the Web App with its own components and shown as plain text everywhere else; a pick fills the composer as ordinary text. Comes with STE-style writing rules for Chinese and English, two scripts that turn a weather lookup and a system snapshot into ready-made blocks, and a checker script that validates every block, scores the draft and prints a self-review rubric before the reply is sent.
